# SB-1011 Safety bulletin: arc flash at the induction power cabinet
Revision: Rev E  
Plant: P3, line P3-L3  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L3-HP03

Hazard description
An arc flash was observed originating at the induction power cabinet feeding the machining hydraulic forging press motor controls. The event produced a flash of light and a brief pressure wave inside the cabinet, resulting in thermal and shrapnel hazards to personnel performing inspection and maintenance work in front of the cabinet. Preliminary evaluation indicates compromised insulation and a loose conductor termination contributed to the fault. Potential consequences include severe burns, eye injury, and secondary injury from ejected components.

Affected equipment
- Induction power cabinet and associated feeder wiring serving EQ-P3-L3-HP03.
- Machining hydraulic forging press #3 control interfaces, including motor starter and contactor assemblies.
- Nearby panels and access areas where personnel perform routine inspections and lockout/tagout.

Required controls
- De-energize and lock out the induction power cabinet before any inspection, verification, or work. Follow SOP-P3-L3-01 for lockout/tagout procedures and SOP-P3-L3-02 for personal protective equipment selection and test requirements. Access is restricted to personnel trained per MM-P3-L3-HP03.
- Inspect all terminations, insulation, and bus connections for thermal damage and mechanical looseness before re-energizing. The main ram bolt torque for Machining hydraulic forging press #3 (EQ-P3-L3-HP03) is 1600 N·m. Verify any bolted electrical and mechanical connections per the maintenance checklist in MM-P3-L3-HP03.
- Replace any damaged conductors, lugs, and insulating materials; use only approved components that meet plant standards. Perform infrared thermography and a physical torque verification after repairs and before return to service.
- Require two-person verification for cabinet reassembly and a witnessed energization. Document findings, corrective actions, and verifications in maintenance records referenced by MM-P3-L3-HP03.

Effective date
Effective immediately. All affected personnel and contractors must comply prior to next access to the induction power cabinet.
